title: Where Is Momo's Hat?
style_suffix: Flat colors, soft pastel palette, simple rounded shapes, thick clean outlines, warm sunny light, simple uncluttered background, no text, no letters, no words.

characters.momo: Momo is a small chubby orange fox cub with a cream white belly and muzzle, big round dark eyes, and a big fluffy orange tail with a white tip.
characters.hat: The hat is a bright red knitted wool hat with a white pompom on top.
characters.rabbit: The rabbit is a small round white rabbit with long upright ears and a pink nose.
characters.bear: The bear is a big round gentle light-brown bear with a tan muzzle and small ears.
characters.duck: The duck is a small plump yellow duck with an orange beak.
characters.bird: The bird is a tiny round sky-blue bird with a small orange beak.
characters.mama: Mama is a bigger slender orange mother fox with a cream white belly, kind eyes, and a pale blue apron.

cover.scene: A cheerful little fox cub named Momo wearing a bright red knitted wool hat with a white pompom, standing in a green meadow with small flowers under a blue sky, smiling happily, front view, centered.

pages.text: Momo has a red hat. She loves her red hat.
pages.scene: The little fox cub Momo stands in a green meadow with small flowers, proudly wearing her bright red knitted wool hat with a white pompom, smiling with joy.

pages.text: One day, the wind blows. Oh no! The hat flies away.
pages.scene: A windy day in the green meadow. The bright red knitted wool hat with a white pompom flies off the little fox cub Momo's head into the sky. Momo reaches up, surprised, mouth open. Leaves swirl in the wind.

pages.text: Momo looks under the tree. No hat.
pages.scene: Exactly one animal in the picture: the bareheaded little fox cub Momo crouches low and peers into the grass under one big round green tree in the meadow, searching with a worried face.

pages.text:
“Rabbit, do you see my red hat?”
“No,” says Rabbit.
pages.scene: Exactly two animals in the picture: the bareheaded little fox cub Momo talks to one single small white rabbit next to a green bush in the meadow. The rabbit shakes its head.

pages.text:
“Bear, do you see my red hat?”
“No,” says Bear.
pages.scene: The little fox cub Momo, not wearing any hat, looks up and talks to a big gentle light-brown bear at the edge of a friendly green forest. The bear shrugs kindly.

pages.text:
“Duck, do you see my red hat?”
“No,” says Duck.
pages.scene: The little fox cub Momo, not wearing any hat, talks to a small plump yellow duck standing by a little round blue pond in the meadow.

pages.text: Momo is sad. Where is her red hat?
pages.scene: The little fox cub Momo, not wearing any hat, sits alone in the green meadow with drooping ears and a sad face, one small white cloud above her head.

pages.text: Look! A bird has the red hat. It is a nest!
pages.scene: The bareheaded little fox cub Momo stands on the grass under a big tree and points up happily with wide surprised eyes. High on a branch above her, one tiny sky-blue bird sits inside the bright red knitted wool hat with a white pompom, using it as a nest. The hat appears only once, up on the branch. Momo's head is bare.

pages.text: Momo sees the baby birds in the hat. They are warm.
pages.scene: Close-up of a tree branch: three tiny fluffy sky-blue baby birds snuggle warmly inside the bright red knitted wool hat with a white pompom, which sits on the branch like a cozy nest. The mother sky-blue bird perches beside them.

pages.text: “You can have my hat,” says Momo. The birds sing.
pages.scene: Wide view. The bareheaded little fox cub Momo sits on the grass in the bottom left corner and smiles up. Far away in the top right corner, high on a tree branch, tiny sky-blue birds sing inside the bright red knitted wool hat nest with a white pompom. Open sky separates Momo from the branch. Little music notes float in the air.

pages.text: Mama knits a new hat for Momo. It is red, too!
pages.scene: Exactly two foxes in the picture: in a cozy warm room, the mother fox Mama gives the little fox cub Momo a brand new bright red knitted wool hat with a white pompom. Momo wears it and beams with joy. A basket of red yarn sits nearby.
